# Polaris: AI Chat Navigator

> Polaris: AI Chat Navigator is a browser extension for navigating, searching, reading, and exporting long ChatGPT conversations.

Polaris also works on the other supported AI chat sites listed below, and is available for Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox. Table-of-contents generation and file export are processed locally in the browser. Conversation content is never uploaded. The website is published at https://polaris-ai.work/ (English) and https://polaris-ai.work/zh/ (Simplified Chinese).

## Features

- Table of Contents: automatically generate a table of contents showing questions, headings, and sections in the sidebar. Click an item to jump directly to the corresponding content and navigate between earlier questions and responses.
- Search: search available headings and sections in the current conversation by keyword and jump to a match. Search does not provide full-text search across all messages, and it does not search across your chat history.
- Outline: view a response as a hierarchical outline. Expand or collapse chapters, read selected content directly in the sidebar, jump to the corresponding place in the original conversation, and copy individual chapters.
- Long Conversation Mode: a Pro feature that helps you navigate and read loaded content in a long conversation. It works with conversation content that has been loaded and is available to Polaris. It does not extend ChatGPT's context window or accelerate AI response generation.
- Copy and export: copy individual chapters, or export available conversation content as Markdown (.md) or HTML. Exports include messages that have been loaded and are available to Polaris; older messages that have not been loaded may not be included. A suggested continuation prompt is available when needed to help continue a previous conversation.

## Scope

- Who it is for: people who use AI chats for research, writing, planning or code and need to find, reread or reuse part of a long conversation.
- Supported sites: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Doubao, Kimi, Qwen, Yuanbao, Diandian AI, Manus, DeepSeek.
- Free limits: two supported sites at a time; the Table of Contents covers messages already loaded on the page.
- Chat data: conversation content is processed locally in the browser and is not sent to the developer or third parties. Pro license checks use a random installation identifier, not your chats.
- Long Conversation Mode keeps more earlier messages available for navigation, but does not guarantee every message is available. Retained messages live only in the current page's memory, are cleared on refresh or when switching chats, and are not written to disk, synced or uploaded.
- Polaris is an independent browser extension and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by OpenAI. It is not affiliated with other AI providers.

## Install

- [Homepage](https://polaris-ai.work/): Product overview, how it works, features, pricing and installation.
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/polaris-ai-chat-navigator/lkdbbnpcfkjdfnopecpbdaeegncdmajb): Official Chrome listing.
- [Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/fiaclpfiiiphgijkinloimjidelcfhgi): Official Edge listing.
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/polaris-ai-chat-navigator/): Official Firefox listing.
- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/Jeffery-Ho/Polaris-AI-Chat-Navigator/releases/latest): Offline ZIP for manual installation.

## Pricing

- Free: two supported platforms at a time, no payment details needed.
- Pro: all supported platforms and Long conversation mode, which keeps more earlier messages in the Table of Contents. One-time purchase, no subscription.
- Current prices are listed on the [homepage](https://polaris-ai.work/): $12.90 during the first 7 days of the free trial, then $19.99.

## Use cases

- [ChatGPT table of contents](https://polaris-ai.work/chatgpt-table-of-contents/): Navigating long ChatGPT conversations on chatgpt.com.
- [Claude conversation navigator](https://polaris-ai.work/claude-conversation-navigator/): Navigating long Claude conversations on claude.ai.
